protocol: A12 controlled packed-RAW motion mechanism diagnostic v1
scope: MIS20S1 A3 training-reference-derived constructed targets; development diagnostic, not independent real dynamic or cross-sensor validation

baseline.name: official_crvd
baseline.purpose: Compare official CRVD initialization and A3 EMA on exactly the same frozen constructed targets, clipped model inputs and inference settings.
limitations: The probe uses an MIS20S1 training-scene reference, artificial integer motion and MIS20S1 synthetic noise.
Differences diagnose behaviour under this construction; they do not establish real-world causal attribution or independent dynamic generalization.
This comparison performs inference only and does not modify either checkpoint.

metric_protocol.raw_input: stored noisy RAW before black-level clipping
metric_protocol.model_input: the same input after channel-wise black subtraction, [0,1] clipping and DN reconstruction
metric_protocol.storage_code_endpoints: exact storage codes 0 and 4095; distinct from black-level normalization endpoints
metric_protocol.normalized_domain_limits: channel-wise (DN-black)/(4095-black); endpoint tolerance 1e-7; raw below-black samples are not claimed to be hardware clipping
metric_protocol.acceptance: report separate reconstruction, structural and temporal target-relative errors; no single-metric pass claim
